open_points.subject: runtime access to the M30–M34 correspondence tables
open_points.text: Like M22–M29 they are the shapes of rows of tables the data provider holds for the release (SPEC_STANDARD §6.10), not reference tables of the specification, which never reach the running service (§5, §15.2).
open_points.question: Which named module capability supplies or reads the M30–M34 tables when a flow needs their correspondences?
options: Generated code imports immutable tables from the data provider
Flows call a data-provider lookup operation
Each consuming module embeds the correspondences independently
open_points.default_guess: Have generated code import one immutable table for each correspondence from the data provider.
